column3: MT 84:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “it is exhausted” is rendered “even yearned.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a home” is rendered “a house,” and “with Your altars” as “Even Your altars.”
Close to the Hebrew; “still they praise You” is rendered “They are ever praising You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he appears” is rendered “Every one of them appears.”
NASB supplies “outside,” and renders “I have chosen” as “I would rather.”
Close to the Hebrew; “favor and honor” is rendered “grace and glory,” and “in blamelessness” as “uprightly.”
